title: project.archive
description: Protocol 1.4 (params 1.2): Archives a project. Error kinds: config, unauthorized, http, not_found, invalid, transport, decode.

base_url.description: Optional; must equal the configured PLANE_BASE_URL (the API key is never sent elsewhere)

workspace.description: Plane workspace slug (optional, falls back to PLANE_WORKSPACE_SLUG)

project_id.description: Plane project ID. Required: the default project is never ended by an empty request
